newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Pacific seeks exchange probe of HK rumours.
newsitem.headline: First Pacific seeks exchange probe of HK rumours.

text.p: Hong Kong blue chip First Pacific Co Ltd has sought a stock market probe into market rumours which have buffetted the group's shares recently, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.

"I have this afternoon asked the stock exchange to look into the share trading patterns which we have noticed in our shares in the last ten days," First Pacific's group vice president, corporate communications, Derek Murphy, said by telephone.
Murphy strongly denied a rumour circulating in the stock market on Wednesday which suggested the company would place shares.
"This rumour is totally and absolutely untrue," he said.
He said the company had no current fund raising plans at this point and was determined to get to the bottom of the rumour-mongering.
